rationale: The operator requested a hard command that every detected error must be repaired before moving on, verified twice, frozen, and only then advanced. This change adds a production readiness runner and Test Center API/dashboard surface that blocks false PROD_READY claims while roadmap freeze evidence is missing. It is D3 because it introduces a public production readiness gate and operator command protocol used to govern release decisions.

steps: Remove Test Center dashboard production readiness card.
Run Test Center route tests twice.
Keep existing roadmap freeze evidence intact.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that production readiness cannot be marked ready with missing FROZEN_2X evidence, that the repair-loop command records the next blocker, and that the Test Center dashboard can display the command and status.
pre_conditions: ProductionReadinessRunner can scan a repository root.
Roadmap freeze evidence files represent completed production items.
steps: Evaluate a temp repository with one missing P0 freeze file and verify BLOCKED.
Evaluate a temp repository with all configured freeze files and verify PROD_READY.
Record a repair-loop command and verify AEIS_PRODUCTION_REPAIR_LOOP plus next blocker.
Run Test Center route tests twice.
Run ESLint and TypeScript checks for the dashboard change.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: False production-ready claims are blocked until every required item is frozen twice, and the dashboard shows the next repair blocker instead of an optimistic ready state.
